roland_ax_synth_black.appearance_notes: Glossy glass-particle black sparkle sculpted rounded keytar; long tapered left handle; deep crescent cutout beneath handle where it joins keyboard body; raised lip around keybed; sweeping lower body, not straight rectangular and not angular AX-Edge. Large italic AX-Synth and Roland text at upper-right when viewed in playable orientation; keys are beneath main panel. Slim red three-character 7-segment display toward panel left/center; row of bank buttons; neck ribbon, modulation bar, D Beam, two rotary controls. Official top product photo stored upside down relative to standard playable layout; rotate mentally.

roland_fantom_8.appearance_notes: Large black/charcoal workstation, dark red side/rear accent, sloping console. Logo Roland/FANTOM upper-left. Pair of wheels far upper-left plus pitch/mod lever lower-left beside keys. Eight vertical faders with LED meters and eight knobs/zone buttons to left of center screen. Center seven-inch color touchscreen, six cyan-ring knobs below it, large encoder to screen right. Synth knob cluster with cyan rings right of screen; far-right 4x4 pads with magenta outlines. Horizontal row of 16 gray category buttons beneath synth/pad section. FANTOM 8 has 88-key A0-C8 range (52 white/36 black). Not FANTOM-08 or FANTOM 8 EX.

roland_d50.appearance_notes: Matte charcoal low wedge; pale blue Roland D-50 Linear Synthesizer logo at upper left. Fine parallel horizontal ribs along rear edge. Joystick in square recess center-left; narrow yellow-green two-line LCD center with gray rectangular controls below/around. White line synthesis structure diagrams occupy right-most top panel third, numeric keypad just left of diagrams. Two vertical sliders and pitch bender lower-left beside keys. Keyboard 61 keys C-C (36 white/25 black). d50-page-03.png is authentic manual front-panel layout rotated 90 degrees in scan. Do not use d50-article-photo.png: unrelated portrait.

roland_jupiter8.appearance_notes: Wide/deep classic analog synth, metal silver end cheeks, black/dark gray sloped control console, rear ventilation slots. Orange section title strips across upper panel grouping LFO, VCO Modulator, VCO1, VCO2, HPF, VCF, VCA, ENV1, ENV2. Dense black knobs/sliders. Distinctive horizontal square button row immediately above keybed in orange/yellow/white/green/blue groups; centered red four-digit display. Huge pale silver JUPITER-8 upper RIGHT, Roland upper LEFT. Left control area beside keybed with pitch bender and modulation sliders/knobs. Original has no large LCD or modern pads. 61 keys C-C (36 white/25 black).

yamaha_dx7.appearance_notes: Dark brown/charcoal flat sloping rectangle with black end cheeks. White/gray YAMAHA DX7 logo upper LEFT. Printed white FM algorithm diagrams across upper-right strip. Distinctive two long rows of flat turquoise/teal membrane buttons center-right; small colored utility button groups to left; narrow olive LCD and red numeric LED to its left at center-left. Two vertical sliders top-left panel. Pair of black pitch/modulation wheels lower-left beside keyboard. 61 keys C-C (36 white/25 black). Original Mk I not DX7II, DX7S or DX7IID.
